title: Jupyter and JupyterLab: the notebook as a working document

videos.script: A notebook is the place most data work starts. {{notebook}} It is also the place a lot of it goes wrong. A cell runs, a number appears, and the number is trusted. {{trusted}} This course is about the tools behind that number. Arrays that need no loop. Tables that survive a real file. Charts that say one thing clearly. {{stack}} And it is about the habits that keep the number honest. {{habits}} Every lesson is something you type and watch happen. So this lesson builds the place where that happens, on your own computer. {{lab}} One folder. A Python of its own. Seven libraries, at the versions this course was recorded with. {{versions}} Then a short program writes the data. A year of trips on the bikes of a city by the sea. {{data}} And then the first notebook. Three programs behind one page: your browser, a server, and a kernel. {{three}} Lesson 2 shows what happens when you forget the third one. {{end}}
